Thanking you, For Wipro Limited M Sanaulla Khan Company Secretary bp signs strategic partnership with Wipro to build best-in-class finance operations LONDON | BENGALURU, India | E. BRUNSWICK, N.J. – Nov. 25, 2026 - bp has today announced a strategic supplier partnership with Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO), a leading AI-powered technology services and consulting company, to transform its core finance operations as it continues to strengthen performance and improve long-term cost competitiveness. The collaboration will bring together Wipro’s expertise in AI, automation, and transformation to drive greater efficiency in bp’s finance operations and improve processes. Under the agreement, around 3,000 bp employees supporting finance operations in India, Hungary and Malaysia will move to Wipro. Kate Thomson, Chief Financial Officer, bp, said, “We believe this partnership with Wipro is the best path forward for bp and our people as we build a simpler, stronger, more valuable bp. It moves us closer to best-in-class finance operations while giving our people opportunities to continue to develop their skills. Wipro brings specialist digital capabilities and investment that will help us make better use of finance operations technology, deliver value for the business more quickly and simplify how we work.” Srini Pallia, Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director, Wipro Limited said, “This landmark engagement with bp underscores our commitment to leveraging our deep domain expertise and Wipro Intelligence to drive large-scale technology transformation. Through this collaboration, we aim to unlock measurable business outcomes for bp in the AI-first world. I also welcome the bp employees joining the Wipro family and look forward to integrating their specialized skills with our consulting-led, AI-powered strategy.” The new operating model is expected to take effect in 2027, subject to applicable conditions. bp will retain overall accountability for standards, controls, data and technology governance, with PwC providing controls oversight. About bp For more information visit: www.bp.com. About Wipro Limited Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading AI-powered technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our consulting-led approach and the Wipro Intelligence™ unified suite of AI-powered platforms, solutions and transformative offerings, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions to build intelligent and sustainable businesses. The Wipro Innovation Network–part of the Wipro Intelligence™ suite–underpins our commitment to client-centric co-innovation and co-creation by bringing together capabilities from the innovation labs and partner labs, academia, and global tech communities. With over 240,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com. Further information bp press office, London: bppress@bp.com Dinesh Joshi, W
